_loader_notes: Ascenda AI v2 (AGENTS.md v2.5). One chat, Ascenda Coach, with tools, plus the monthly recap. Replaces the six separate features. Scan a machine is removed.
Prompts live in content/ai/prompts and are loaded by Supabase Edge Functions; never ship them in the app. Claude API key is an Edge Function secret.
Tools: the model only chooses which tool to call and with what inputs. Every tool runs Ascenda's own code (server_runs) and returns a validated result. Cards need her tap before anything changes.

Build the per-turn payload exactly as in conversations.per_turn_payload. Re-sending context and retrieved guides every turn is what stops the coach losing track of what 'this' means or retracting earlier answers.
Use prompt caching for the system prompt and cached_context. Send per-turn data in the user message inside <context>, <her_training> and <retrieved> tags.
Log every call to ai_usage. Never send prompt or answer text to PostHog.
Before launch, a qualified coach reviews 50 Coach conversations (including tool use) and the evals; fix the prompt until they pass.

coach.model_note: Start with Haiku. Move to claude-sonnet-5-5 only if the evals or coach review show Haiku isn't good enough at tool choice or answers.

card_ids.description: ids of tool results (cards) to show under this reply, in order

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Fetch an exercise guide, machine guide, Learn article, routine, stretch or cardio session by id, or search them by words. Use when <retrieved> doesn't have what you need.
tools.server_runs: Look up /content (Supabase). Search = keyword match on names, aliases and summaries; return at most 3 items, each trimmed to the fields the coach needs.

tools.name: my_training
tools.description: Get more of her own training data than <her_training> includes: sessions in a date range, history for one exercise, personal bests or checkpoint results.
tools.server_runs: Query her own sessions and sets only (RLS). Return exercise names, sets, reps and weights; never bodyweight or photos.

tools.name: adjust_today
tools.description: Rework the rest of today's session when something's taken, she's short on time, her energy is low, or she wants to remove or swap an exercise. Keeps the day's movement patterns.
tools.server_runs: Swap engine plus time fitter: swaps come only from each exercise's guide swaps that avoid the unavailable equipment and her saved preferences; to save time drop core then accessories, then reduce secondary sets; keep the main lift if possible; low energy cuts sets by about a third. Applies to today only, after she taps Use this.

tools.name: build_session
tools.description: Build a one-off session from Ascenda's library.

card.shows: blocks and exercises with sets and reps

tools.server_runs: Deterministic session builder (no AI): warm-up template for the focus; strength block from her level's progression-ladder rung for each pattern the focus needs, avoiding patterns trained heavily in the last 48 hours and her saved preferences; prescriptions by role and level; optional cardio finisher; cool-down. Fits the minutes using the timing table. Cardio and recovery focus pick a cardio session or stretch routine instead.

tools.name: recommend_routine
tools.description: Recommend routines using Ascenda's recommendation rules. Fill in what she's told you; use her profile for anything she hasn't mentioned.

card.shows: top routine plus 2 alternatives with schedule_label

tools.server_runs: Run the onboarding recommendation rules and fit_rule, then filter by equipment_focus. Return the top routine and 2 alternatives with their why_lines. Never returns a routine needing more gym days than days_per_week.

tools.name: move_session
tools.description: Move one of her planned sessions to another day.
tools.server_runs: Checks the session is hers and the date is valid; moves it only after she taps Confirm.

tools.name: save_preference
tools.description: Save a lasting preference when she asks Ascenda to always avoid an exercise, or says her gym doesn't have some equipment. The swap engine then applies it everywhere.

card.shows: the preference in plain English, and that she can remove it in Profile

tools.server_runs: Stored in coach_preferences after she taps Save. Never save a medical reason: if she mentions pain or injury, redirect to a GP or physio and don't call this tool.

tools.name: find_recipes
tools.description: Find recipes from Ascenda's reviewed recipes that use ingredients she has.

card.shows: 3 to 5 recipes with 'You have 6 of 8 ingredients'

tools.server_runs: Map only to ingredient keys from the cached ingredient list. Server ranks by matched non-pantry ingredients; never generates recipes.

cached_context: app_help (short notes on how Ascenda's features work)
exercise index (slug, name, equipment, pattern) and machine index
server_validation: every link id and card id exists
tool inputs only use known ids, else return a tool error to the model
no em dashes in reply (replace with commas)
safety_flag emergency shows the emergency card above the reply
coach.fallback: If the model times out or validation fails twice: show the most relevant guide or article for her message, and the matching non-AI action (Swap, Find a routine, Planner).

recap.runs: Once per user per month (scheduled), only if she trained at least twice last month.
server_validation: every number in headline and story appears in the stats
no banned words: missed, skipped, only, behind, weight, calories, body
highlight is a key in stats
recap.fallback: Template: '{sessions} sessions and {minutes} minutes of training in {month}. That's something to be proud of.'

entry_points.header_button: Coach icon next to the profile avatar on every tab. Opens her most recent chat if she used it in the last 6 hours, otherwise a new chat with no context.
entry_points.contextual: 'Ask Coach' buttons and suggested-question chips on exercise pages, the logger (header ⋯ and each exercise ⋯ menu), routine pages, machine guides, recipes and Learn articles. Each opens a NEW chat with that context attached and the tapped question already sent.
entry_points.logger_shortcut: 'Something's taken' in the logger opens a new chat with today's session as context and the message 'Something's taken'.

context_object.type: exercise | machine | session_today | routine | recipe | article | none
context_object.label: shown as a chip at the top of the chat, e.g. 'About: Leg extension'

per_turn_payload: <context>: the context object plus its full guide or record (re-sent every turn)
<her_training>: current routine, this week's plan, last 5 sessions (exercise names, sets, reps, weights), saved coach_preferences
<retrieved>: up to 3 guides or articles matched to this message (keyword match on the message plus the context); store the retrieved ids with each assistant message
history: the last 12 messages plus a running summary of older ones
new_chat_rules: New chat button in the chat header
Contextual entry always starts a new chat
Header button starts a new chat after 6 hours of inactivity
Each chat is titled from her first message (first 40 characters, no AI)
conversations.storage: ai_conversations (context_type, context_id, title, last_message_at) and ai_messages (role, content, card payloads, retrieved_ids). Kept 30 days, deletable one by one or all in Profile, Privacy. Never used to train models.

new_chat: Why is my plan set up like this?
How should my next session feel?
exercise: What can I swap this for?
machine: How do I set this up?
What can I do on this?
routine: Why does this routine suit me?
Can I do this on different days?
recipe: What can I swap in this?
chips._note: 'How heavy should I go?' style questions are answered by explaining reps in reserve and the suggested-weight chip, never with a number.

ui_copy.title: Ascenda Coach
ui_copy.label: AI-generated, not medical advice.
ui_copy.limit_reached: You've reached today's limit for Coach. It resets tomorrow.
ui_copy.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
ui_copy.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui_copy.card_saved: Saved. You can change this in Profile, Coach preferences.
ui_copy.emergency_card: If you feel chest pain, severe breathlessness or faint, stop and get medical help now. In an emergency, call 999.
ui_copy.delete_all_body: This deletes all your Coach conversations. It can't be undone.
ui_copy.empty: Ask about any exercise, machine or your plan, or let Coach adjust today's session for you.
ui_copy.recap_share_note: Your recap card shows numbers only, never photos or body data.
